explanation.explanation: Panel A is a 3D rendering/cartoon of a tomographic reconstruction (pre-conoidal rings and actin filament), not a quantitative plot with axes.
Panel B is a 3D segmentation rendering of the basal end of a sporozoite, an image not a quantitative graph.
Panel C is a tomogram slice image (a micrograph) with a scale bar (100 nm), not a plot with quantitative axes.
Panel D is a 3D cartoon/rendering of a lateral section of the cell showing labeled structures, not a quantitative plot.
Panel E is an averaged tomographic slice image with a scale bar (25 nm), not a plot with quantitative axes.
Panel F is a tomogram slice image with a scale bar (50 nm), not a plot with quantitative axes.
